items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And there was a guy, a professor at City College... His name was Mr. Kennedy. And he had all these records stacked in his garage.

ctx.x: Oh, they had stuff going on in that band that was really somethin' else. And they had an arrangement of "When The Swallows Come Back to Capistano" that had twelve out-choruses, building, ensemble, the whole band -- twelve. And when they got to the last one, you'd think that building was going to come down. It was just utterly fan-tastic.

And there was a guy, a professor at City College who had access to this big recording, where they used to make these great, big, round dubs, you know... He used to record every night. He had all of Ellington's, he had all of Lunceford's. And he lost his mind. He went crazy. His name was Mr. Kennedy. And he had all these records stacked in his garage. And he went and got some dynamite, and he got inside the garage, and he lit the match. And he went -- and so did the records. Mr. Kennedy, he went...something…
